CustomField.description: Formula field populated dependent on Parent record type and the Asset Status, Asset Status (Service) or the Not Taken up field being flagged
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( Initiation__r.RecordType.DeveloperName ="Contract_Hire", Initiation__r.RecordType.DeveloperName="Lease_with_R_M" ), AND( ISPICKVAL( Asset_status__c , 'Pack ready'), ISPICKVAL(Asset_status_service__c , 'Second checks complete') ), IF ( Initiation__r.RecordType.DeveloperName ="Stand_Alone_Finance", ISPICKVAL( Asset_status__c , 'Pack ready'), IF ( Initiation__r.RecordType.DeveloperName ="Stane_Alone_Service", ISPICKVAL(Asset_status_service__c , 'Second checks complete'), TRUE ) ) )
CustomField.label: Is delivered
